user_query: I want to get a list of EV charging stations within a 5-mile radius of a conference venue in Los Angeles, including opening hours and available connectors.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the geographical coordinates of the conference venue in Los Angeles.
Search for EV charging stations within a 5-mile radius of the geographical coordinates obtained in Step 1.
Fetch detailed information for each charging station, including opening hours and the number of available connectors.
